question: The area of a quadrilateral ABCD is 299 cm² . The lengths of the perpendiculars from the vertices B and D to the diagonal AC are 11 cm and 12 cm, respectively. Determine the length (in cm) of the diagonal AC.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of **quadrilateral** = 1/2 × **diagonal** × (sum of **perpendiculars**)

299 = 1/2 × AC × (11 + 12)

299 = 1/2 × AC × 23

AC = (299 × 2) ÷ 23

AC = 13 × 2 = 26 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 26 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of **quadrilateral ABCD** = 299 cm²

Perpendicular from vertex B (h₁) = 11 cm

Perpendicular from vertex D (h₂) = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of **quadrilateral** = 1/2 × d × (h₁ + h₂), where d is the **diagonal**.
